text: {"overall_winner":"B","qualities":[{"evidence":"clear opening position and roadmap","quality":"organization","description":"It presents a thesis early and previews the main reasons the essay will use."},{"evidence":"paragraphs starting with \"First,\" \"Next,\" and \"Then,\"","quality":"structure","description":"It uses a more deliberate sequence of body paragraphs to separate and develop points."},{"evidence":"repeated explanation after quotations","quality":"elaboration","description":"It does more than quote the article by explaining how each detail supports the claim."},{"evidence":"\"This means that...\" and \"So therefore...\"","quality":"reasoning","description":"It more clearly connects evidence to its conclusion instead of just listing facts."},{"evidence":"concluding restatement of the claim","quality":"closure","description":"It ends by restating its position and giving a final takeaway for the reader."}]}
